body:
# 🌿 AutoBamboo

A simple Minecraft mod that automatically collects bamboo when you open a chest.

This mod will save you so much time on servers – give it a shot!

---

## 📌 Features

• Bamboo goes directly into your inventory when opening chests  
• Press **Right Shift** to turn the mod ON or OFF  
• Works on both **client** and **server** side  
• No complex settings – just works!

---

## 🔧 Requirements

| Required | Version |
|----------|---------|
| Minecraft | 1.21.5 |
| Fabric Loader | 1.18.4 or higher |
| Fabric API | 1.21.5 (must have) |

> ⚠️ Fabric API is **required** – mod will not work without it.

---

## 🚀 How to Install

1. Install **Fabric Loader** for Minecraft 1.21.5  
2. Download **Fabric API** for 1.21.5  
3. Download **AutoBamboo** mod  
4. Put both `.jar` files in your `.minecraft/mods` folder  
5. Launch Minecraft and enjoy!

---

## 🎮 How to Use

• Find bamboo near water or jungle areas  
• Place a chest nearby  
• Open the chest – bamboo will be collected automatically  
• Want to stop? Press **Right Shift** to disable  
• Press **Right Shift** again to enable

---
